# Mastery Tutor

> Open-source, local-first mastery learning system for compatible AI agents.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fanfanfanfanfan626/mastery-tutor
Source version: 0.5.0 release candidate
Latest tagged release: 0.4.1 under the former Mastery Learning identity
License: MIT
Languages: English, Simplified Chinese

## What it does

- Creates guided HTML lessons and local learning workspaces.
- Uses hands-on practice, independent retrieval, application, transfer checks, and delayed review.
- Gives staged hints without immediately leaking answers.
- Stores learner-owned progress in `.mastery/` workspaces without a hosted account or database.
- Uses two required Skills together: `mastery-coach` and `mastery-tool-creator`.

## Compatibility boundary

- Codex: engineering-verified; fresh-conversation E2 evidence pending for 0.5.0.
- Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: experimental adapters.
- Generic Agent Skills hosts: core-compatible packaging.
- Automated tests do not prove learning outcomes.

Compatibility evidence: https://github.com/fanfanfanfanfan626/mastery-tutor/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md
